author: Fouled
body:
Even though he's already an admin (basically every rank), we decided to make a topic about his recent promotion to map developer, to notify you guys about it. He really wanted to help out, and we thought he would be a good addition to the team.
Congratulations, and welcome to the map developer team, Peachy/Vacuum!
